fed1d8f3-8725-4bfe-98e9-966cbc6cd636.name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Hold the dumbbells at your sides with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise out to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly — this one is about control, not load.

a16fb425-58fa-4b5a-986a-46e83438ce87.name: Push-Up
instructions: Set your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lower until your chest is just off the floor, then press back up.

6977e7a1-7149-47a4-ad9c-78e28c515707.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to about 30 degrees.
Start with the dumbbells at chest level, elbows slightly tucked.
Press up and slightly together, then lower slowly.

51a3c120-2dcd-4240-bed7-e2fc320775e2.name: Deadlift
instructions: Set the bar over mid-foot and grip just outside your shins.
Take the slack out of the bar and set a flat back.
Push the floor away and stand tall, keeping the bar close.
Return the bar along the same path.

a3c188d6-caa2-4771-8374-94a3808f3d11.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat with your eyes under the bar and set your feet.
Grip just wider than shoulder width and pull your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar to mid-chest under control.
Press back to straight arms without letting your ribs flare.

c839440f-fc51-4266-82c0-688234173bf2.name: Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and brace hard.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend to at least parallel, then drive the floor away.

63df6222-c627-456a-9ee7-a362514900b5.name: Plank
instructions: Set your elbows under your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace as if about to be pushed.
Hold a straight line — stop the set when your hips drop.
